MIND. [1] [Chel.]
Delirium. θ Influenza. θ Pneumonia.
Quiet delirium, mostly at night, followed by lethargy which continues through the day.
Distaste for mental exertion and conversation. θ Dyspepsia. θ Indigestion.
Anxiety : allowing no rest at any employment ; as if she had committed a crime ; fear of getting crazy, with restlessness and heat.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Chel.]
Vertigo : with bilious vomiting and pain in liver ; with confusion of head ; with stumbling, as if to fall forward ; with mental disturbance ; on closing eyes, as if everything was turning in a circle ; on sitting up in bed ; with shivering over upper part of body ; on attempting to rise in morning, keeping her in bed. θ Influenza. θ Valvular disease. θ Dyspepsia. θ Hemorrhoids. θ Chorea.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Chel.]
Drawing in nape and occiput. θ Influenza.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Chel.]
Right supraorbital neuralgia.
Stitches above left eye.
Increased secretion of Meibomian glands.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Chel.]
The usual redness of cheeks has a mixture of yellow, of a dark color.
Greyish-yellow, sallow, sunken countenance. θ Hepatic affections. θ Dyspepsia.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Chel.]
Tongue thickly coated yellow, with red margin, showing imprint of teeth.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Chel.]
Mucus in mouth and tough mucous saliva.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Chel.]
Loss of appetite, with disgust and nausea.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Chel.]
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Chel.]
Nausea in hepatitis and vomiting of pregnancy.
Bilious vomiting.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Chel.]
Constriction, tension and sensitiveness in pit of stomach and right hypochondrium. θ Hepatic affections. θ Dyspepsia.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Chel.]
Stitches in region of liver.
Pains from region of liver, shooting towards back and shoulder.
Pressive pain in region of liver.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Chel.]
Pain across umbilicus, as if abdomen was constricted by a string.
Abdominal plethora. θ Hemorrhoids. θ Liver affections.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Chel.]
Diarrhœa and constipation alternately.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Chel.]
Pressure on larynx, as if air could not pass through ; as if swollen ; more to the right.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Chel.]
Short and quick breathing ; with oppression, which is relieved by a few deep inspirations ; with anxiety, as if he must choke.
Nightly attacks of asthma with a sense of constriction in chest ; region of diaphragm.
   

COUGH. [27] [Chel.]
Spasmodic cough without expectoration ; or, with forcible ejection of small lumps of mucus.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Chel.]
Stitches in chest, < right side.
Deep-seated pain in whole right side of chest.
Oppression of chest ; clothing seemed too tight.
Soreness in lower ribs, right side.
Hæmoptysis. θ Pneumonia.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Chel.]
Stitches beneath right scapula.
Red miliary eruption on neck, chest and arms. θ Acute rheumatism.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Chel.]
Fixed pain under inner angle of right scapula ; often accompanies cough, diarrhœa, pneumonia, menses, loss of milk, exhaustion, etc.
Pain in right shoulder.
Tips of fingers cold.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Chel.]
Drawing pain in hips, thighs, legs and feet, more right side.
Pain in right knee, with burning and stiffness ; < when moving.
Stiffness of ankles.
Foot highly œdematous, most around ankle ; swelling a little reddened and hard over inner ankle. θ Acute rheumatism.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Chel.]
Neuralgia in limbs. θ Bright's disease.
Rheumatism, least touch anywhere is exceedingly painful ; sweat without relief.
Limbs : feel heavy, stiff and lame ; feel paralyzed ; cold.
Limbs flabby. θ Intestinal catarrh.
   

NERVES. [36] [Chel.]
Trembling and twitching of limbs.
Tonic spasms in flexors of fingers and toes.
Lethargy. θ Valvular disease.
Great debility and lassitude.
Weariness, indolence, indisposed to work.
Neuralgia, particularly right supraorbital.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Chel.]
Sleepy, lethargic in daytime. θ Jaundice.
Sleepiness, desire to lie, without being able to sleep.
   

FEVER. [40] [Chel.]
Attacks of rigor in evening. θ Liver complaint.
Rigor, followed by heat and sorrowful, anxious mood. θ Valvular disease.
Burning heat of hands, spreading from thence over body.
Sweat during sleep, after midnight and towards morning ; > after awaking.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Chel.]
Right : inflammation of lung.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Chel.]
External neuralgia.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Chel.]
Chronic, gastric and intestinal catarrhs, with decreased secretion of bile, great lassitude and heaviness of limbs, headache and inability to think.
Hepatitis ; jaundice ; fatty liver ; painful enlargement of liver ; gall stones ; bilious condition in general.
Distension of veins ; abdominal plethora ; hemorrhoids.
Yellow-grey color of skin.
   

SKIN. [46] [Chel.]
Yellow, yellowish-grey, wilted skin. θ Hepatic affections. θ Intestinal catarrh. θ Valvular disease. θ Typhus.
Itching of skin.
Red and painful pimples and pustules on various parts.
Old putrid spreading ulcers.
